text:
emma: Deploybot held canary for image ecr://redwood/runtime:canary-2026-05-02 — publish-quarantine.

deploybot: [automated] publish-quarantine: provenance annotation mismatch across manifest entries (linux/amd64 vs linux/arm64). summary:
```
namd64.annotations.provenance length=640
arm64.annotations.provenance length=256  # looks truncated
```

lucas: looks like the arm64 cosign upload errored mid-stream and we retried the job which left a partial attestation.

priya: checked runner logs `curl: (18) transfer closed with outstanding read data` during cosign blob push. pipeline continued after retry but no attestation merge.

release-coordinator: options: 1) pin to last-known-good digest and postpone canary; 2) attempt in-place re-sign (risky); 3) rebuild and push new tag. what's low-risk for customers?

emma: pin + postpone. customers shouldn't get a half-signed image. pin to `ecr://redwood/runtime@sha256:d3a7f1...ef9` from yesterday and announce in release notes. no manual retags of the broken manifest.

lucas: I'll open a PR to update the release manifest to the pinned digest and schedule republish in 04:00 UTC change window.

priya: i'll harden cosign uploader (multipart/timeout bump) and add a manifest parity check after push. will attach logs to INF ticket.

deploybot: action recorded: hold persists. recommended actions: [pin->ecr://redwood/runtime@sha256:d3a7f1...ef9, schedule republish 04:00 UTC, update release notes: "Canary deferred due to provenance annotation mismatch; serving pinned to previous digest"].

release-coordinator: change window approved. i'll add PSA to #support and the public notes draft.

emma: once republish passes canary please post final digest and close thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
